request: Determine whether an anonymous reader who is not the bookmark owner may read the same existing asset via GET assets/<asset_id>.

policySources.text: The owner may read an asset; authenticated readers may read it when its bookmark is shared and owner sharing is enabled; anonymous readers require public sharing enabled.
